Name: Scale Up 2
Author: Platonymous
Description:
[center][heading]ScaleUp 2[/heading] by Platonymous
[line]Allows adding larger and or higher resolution textures via ContentPatcher
[size=2]﻿
[/size][b]Important: Currently only available for the Stardew Valley 1.6 alpha !![/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/T5Eybda.png[/img]
The mod on it's own does nothing.
Allows adding scaled images with highter resolution and/or add extra pixels to the sprites.
When adding a texture in contentpatcher, add another entry that specifies the scaleup parameters:[/center]
[code] {
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "{{Platonymous.ScaleUp/Assets}}",
"Entries": 
{
"Playtonymous.ScaleUpExample_Plant_Crop": {
"Asset": "Mods/Playtonymous.ScaleUpExample_Plant/Crops",
"Scale": 4,
"PaddingWidth": 120,
"PaddingHeight": 56
}
}
}
[/code]
[center]Scale: The scale of the image, can be left out if the sale is 1,
PaddingWidth: The extra number of pixels you added to the width of the image (if scaled, the scaled pixels added)
PaddingWidth: The extra number of pixels you added to the height of the image (if scaled, the scaled pixels added)
When adding pixel to a tiled image, use the total pixels added in the parameter, but make sure that every tile has the same extra pixels.
(Padding can be left out if you did not add any pixel to the image)

Example in the downloads under Optional
﻿[/center][center][img]https://imgur.com/b8d5H2A.png[/img]﻿
If you have any questions or feature requests you can usually find me on the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Community#Discord]Stardew Valley Discord[/url]﻿ under the username [b]Routine[/b]#8715
